Based on my search, I can provide you with comprehensive information about **CFA Institute membership**. This covers the requirements, fees, and types of membership available.

## CFA Institute Membership Overview

CFA Institute offers different types of membership, and **Regular Membership is a prerequisite to earning the CFA charter** — you cannot use the "CFA" designation without it.

---

## Types of Membership

### 1. **Regular Membership**
- **Who it's for:** Investment professionals directly involved in or supporting the investment decision-making process
- **Requirements:**
  - Bachelor's degree or equivalent education/work experience
  - Passing score on Level I CFA Exam (or equivalent)
  - At least **4,000 hours of relevant work experience**, completed in a minimum of **36 months**
  - **2 professional references** if one is an active regular member of your local CFA society, **OR 3 references** if none are active members

### 2. **Affiliate Membership**
- **Who it's for:** Investment professionals who don't meet regular membership eligibility
- **Requirements:**
  - Passing score on Level I CFA Exam
  - No work experience required
  - Same reference requirements as regular membership

---

## Membership Fees (2025-2026)

| Component | Cost |
|-----------|------|
| **CFA Institute Annual Dues (Global)** | **USD $299/year** |
| **CFA Society India Dues** | **INR 5,000 + 18% GST** (~INR 5,900) |
| **Professional Leave (reduced dues)** | USD $100 (CFA Institute) / INR 2,000 + GST (India) |

**Note:** CFA Institute dues are discounted for certain countries, including India.

---

## Key Changes for 2026

- The **one-time $350 enrollment fee was abolished** starting February 2026
- Registration fees per level were adjusted upward accordingly:
  - **Level I & II:** Early $1,140 / Standard $1,490
  - **Level III:** Early $1,240 / Standard $1,590

---

## Maintaining Your Charter

After earning the CFA charter:
- You must maintain **active Regular Membership** ($299/year)
- You must also belong to a **local CFA society** (required for Institute membership)
- If membership lapses, you lose the right to use the "CFA" designation — but you can reactivate by paying back dues

---

## Membership Application Process

1. Complete application on CFA Institute website: Personal Profile, Address, Education, Work Experience, Select Society, References
2. Pay CFA Institute dues
3. Pay local society dues separately (e.g., CFA Society India collects dues in INR)
4. Application review: up to 10 business days (CFA Institute) + up to 1 month (local society)

---

## Sources:

1. https://300hours.com/cfa-exam-cost/
2. https://capstonelearnings.com/cfa-vs-frm-india/
3. https://www.zelleducation.com/blog/cfa-membership-fees/
4. https://cfasocietyindia.org/membership/
5. https://corpready.in/resources/articles/146-cfa-course-details-india.html
6. https://300hours.com/cfa-requirements/
